title: Customizations
description: V8 — Everyday: customizations for people using agents, not building them. Connections (what a session can reach) and skills (workflows it knows), with session toggles in a composer Connections pill, a two-list side panel, and in-chat moments (connect a linked tool, sign in again, what was used, save a workflow as a skill). V7's "How it runs" is one step away for authors.
